meanings.en: the quality of being dark, dim, or unclear
meanings.exampleEn: The murkiness of the water made it impossible to see the bottom.
meanings.exampleTr: Suyun bulanıklığı dibi görmeyi imkânsız kılıyordu.

meanings.en: relating to the work of a secretary
meanings.exampleEn: She took a secretarial course to improve her office skills.
meanings.exampleTr: Ofis becerilerini geliştirmek için bir sekreterlik kursuna gitti.

meanings.en: to remove an obstruction from something
meanings.exampleEn: The plumber came to unblock the kitchen sink.
meanings.exampleTr: Tesisatçı mutfak lavabosunun tıkanıklığını açmaya geldi.

meanings.en: the closing of a factory, business, or system
meanings.exampleEn: The factory shutdown left hundreds of workers unemployed.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrikanın kapanması yüzlerce işçiyi işsiz bıraktı.

meanings.en: clothes, especially fine or formal ones
meanings.exampleEn: Guests were asked to wear formal attire to the ceremony.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuklardan törene resmi kıyafet giymeleri istendi.

meanings.en: awkward and clumsy in movement or appearance
meanings.exampleEn: The young giraffe took its first ungainly steps.
meanings.exampleTr: Genç zürafa ilk hantal adımlarını attı.

meanings.en: quick and light in movement or thought
meanings.exampleEn: The nimble dancer leapt across the stage with ease.
meanings.exampleTr: Çevik dansçı sahnenin bir ucundan diğerine kolayca sıçradı.

meanings.en: the act of teaching a person or small group privately
meanings.exampleEn: She earns extra money by tutoring high school students in math.
meanings.exampleTr: Lise öğrencilerine matematik özel dersi vererek ek para kazanıyor.

meanings.en: having a rough texture or appearing speckled and unclear
meanings.exampleEn: The old photograph was grainy and hard to make out.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski fotoğraf taneliydi ve seçmesi zordu.

meanings.en: the line where land meets a sea or lake
meanings.exampleEn: We walked along the shoreline collecting shells.
meanings.exampleTr: Kıyı şeridi boyunca yürüyerek deniz kabukları topladık.

meanings.en: the land along the edge of the sea
meanings.exampleEn: The children built sandcastles on the seashore.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar deniz kıyısında kumdan kaleler yaptılar.

meanings.en: a drink made by combining alcohol with other ingredients
meanings.exampleEn: The bartender prepared a mixed drink with rum and pineapple juice.
meanings.exampleTr: Barmen rom ve ananas suyuyla karışık bir içki hazırladı.

meanings.en: the seeds from which cocoa and chocolate are made
meanings.exampleEn: Chocolate is produced from the roasted seeds of the cacao tree.
meanings.exampleTr: Çikolata, kakao ağacının kavrulmuş çekirdeklerinden üretilir.

meanings.en: the quality of being steady and unchanging, or the thickness of a substance
meanings.exampleEn: His consistency in training led to remarkable results.
meanings.exampleTr: Antrenmanlardaki tutarlılığı dikkate değer sonuçlara yol açtı.

meanings.en: the quality of being unclear and not logically connected
meanings.exampleEn: The incoherence of his argument confused the audience.
meanings.exampleTr: Argümanının tutarsızlığı dinleyicilerin kafasını karıştırdı.

meanings.en: an unlikely chance occurrence, especially a lucky one
meanings.exampleEn: Winning the match was just a fluke, not real skill.
meanings.exampleTr: Maçı kazanması gerçek bir yetenek değil, sadece şans eseriydi.

meanings.en: a person who collects things, especially food from nature
meanings.exampleEn: Early humans lived as hunters and gatherers.
meanings.exampleTr: İlk insanlar avcı ve toplayıcı olarak yaşadı.

meanings.en: a person who collects and stores large amounts of things
meanings.exampleEn: My uncle is a hoarder who never throws anything away.
meanings.exampleTr: Amcam hiçbir şeyi atmayan bir istifçidir.

meanings.en: the combination of two words that commonly go together
meanings.exampleEn: The exercise asked students to find the correct word pairing for each verb.
meanings.exampleTr: Alıştırma, öğrencilerden her fiil için doğru sözcük eşleştirmesini bulmalarını istedi.

meanings.en: relating to an empire or an emperor
meanings.exampleEn: The imperial palace was decorated with gold and silk.
meanings.exampleTr: İmparatorluk sarayı altın ve ipekle süslenmişti.

meanings.en: the state of not being awake or aware
meanings.exampleEn: The blow to his head caused a brief unconsciousness.
meanings.exampleTr: Kafasına aldığı darbe kısa bir bilinçsizliğe yol açtı.

meanings.en: in a warm, comfortable, and snug way
meanings.exampleEn: They sat cosily by the fire on the cold winter night.
meanings.exampleTr: Soğuk kış gecesinde ateşin başında sıcacık oturdular.

meanings.en: a person of lower rank or position than another
meanings.exampleEn: The manager delegated the task to a subordinate.
meanings.exampleTr: Yönetici görevi bir astına devretti.

meanings.en: a group of states or organizations united under one authority
meanings.exampleEn: The sports federation organizes national championships every year.
meanings.exampleTr: Spor federasyonu her yıl ulusal şampiyonalar düzenler.

meanings.en: unwilling to share thoughts or feelings
meanings.exampleEn: He was reticent about his plans for the future.
meanings.exampleTr: Gelecekle ilgili planları konusunda ağzı sıkıydı.

meanings.en: free from conflict and pleasingly combined
meanings.exampleEn: The two families enjoyed a harmonious relationship for years.
meanings.exampleTr: İki aile yıllarca uyumlu bir ilişki yaşadı.

meanings.en: unable to exist or work together harmoniously
meanings.exampleEn: The new software is incompatible with my old computer.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni yazılım benim eski bilgisayarımla uyumsuz.

meanings.en: money claimed or awarded as compensation for loss or injury
meanings.exampleEn: The court ordered the company to pay damages to the victims.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkeme şirketin mağdurlara tazminat ödemesine karar verdi.

meanings.en: the inability to do something successfully
meanings.exampleEn: The project failed due to the manager's incompetence.
meanings.exampleTr: Proje, yöneticinin beceriksizliği yüzünden başarısız oldu.

meanings.en: the natural colour of something, or a substance used to colour it
meanings.exampleEn: The drink contains no artificial colouring.
meanings.exampleTr: İçecek hiçbir yapay renklendirici içermiyor.

meanings.en: the quality of being complex and detailed
meanings.exampleEn: The intricacy of the clock's mechanism amazed everyone.
meanings.exampleTr: Saatin mekanizmasının karmaşıklığı herkesi hayrete düşürdü.

meanings.en: the quality of being easy to understand or uncomplicated
meanings.exampleEn: The beauty of the design lies in its simplicity.
meanings.exampleTr: Tasarımın güzelliği sadeliğinde yatıyor.

meanings.en: the inability to understand something
meanings.exampleEn: She stared at the equation in total incomprehension.
meanings.exampleTr: Denkleme tam bir anlayamama içinde baktı.

meanings.en: the act of pressing something firmly together
meanings.exampleEn: The squeezing of the lemon released its fresh juice.
meanings.exampleTr: Limonun sıkılması taze suyunu açığa çıkardı.

meanings.en: required by law or rules; compulsory
meanings.exampleEn: Wearing a seatbelt is mandatory in most countries.
meanings.exampleTr: Emniyet kemeri takmak çoğu ülkede zorunludur.

meanings.en: required by rule, law, or custom
meanings.exampleEn: Attendance at the meeting is obligatory for all staff.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantıya katılım tüm personel için zorunludur.

meanings.en: done by choice and not because of obligation
meanings.exampleEn: She does voluntary work at the local hospital.
meanings.exampleTr: Yerel hastanede gönüllü iş yapıyor.

meanings.en: an offensive attitude of superiority over others
meanings.exampleEn: His arrogance made it hard for others to work with him.
meanings.exampleTr: Kibri, başkalarının onunla çalışmasını zorlaştırdı.

meanings.en: the quality of not boasting about one's abilities
meanings.exampleEn: Despite her success, she spoke with great modesty.
meanings.exampleTr: Başarısına rağmen büyük bir alçakgönüllülükle konuştu.

meanings.en: able to be thought of or imagined
meanings.exampleEn: They tried every imaginable solution to fix the problem.
meanings.exampleTr: Sorunu çözmek için akla gelebilecek her çözümü denediler.

meanings.en: impossible to imagine or believe
meanings.exampleEn: It was inconceivable that he would betray his closest friend.
meanings.exampleTr: En yakın arkadaşına ihanet etmesi akıl almazdı.

meanings.en: to publicly criticize or condemn someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: Several leaders denounced the attack as an act of terror.
meanings.exampleTr: Birkaç lider saldırıyı bir terör eylemi olarak kınadı.

meanings.en: a material that does not easily conduct heat or electricity
meanings.exampleEn: Rubber is a good insulator and protects against electric shock.
meanings.exampleTr: Lastik iyi bir yalıtkandır ve elektrik çarpmasına karşı korur.

meanings.en: to admit that you are responsible for something wrong
meanings.exampleEn: He finally owned up to breaking the window.
meanings.exampleTr: Sonunda camı kırdığını itiraf etti.

meanings.en: certainly; without doubt
meanings.exampleEn: He will assuredly succeed if he keeps working this hard.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu kadar çok çalışmaya devam ederse kesinlikle başaracak.

meanings.en: in a way that shows uncertainty or reluctance
meanings.exampleEn: She hesitantly raised her hand to ask a question.
meanings.exampleTr: Soru sormak için tereddütle elini kaldırdı.

meanings.en: a thing that links two or more items together
meanings.exampleEn: You need the right connector to plug the cable into the screen.
meanings.exampleTr: Kabloyu ekrana takmak için doğru konnektöre ihtiyacın var.

meanings.en: the act of gaining control of a company or organization
meanings.exampleEn: The company faced a hostile takeover by its rival.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, rakibi tarafından düşmanca bir devralmayla karşı karşıya kaldı.

meanings.en: feelings of doubt about whether an action is morally right
meanings.exampleEn: He had no scruples about lying to get what he wanted.
meanings.exampleTr: İstediğini elde etmek için yalan söyleme konusunda hiçbir vicdani endişesi yoktu.

meanings.tr: az miktarda, çok az, marjinal olarak
meanings.en: by a small amount; slightly
meanings.exampleEn: Sales were only marginally higher than last year.
meanings.exampleTr: Satışlar geçen yıla göre yalnızca çok az daha yüksekti.

meanings.en: not staying the same or not in agreement
meanings.exampleEn: His performance has been inconsistent throughout the season.
meanings.exampleTr: Performansı sezon boyunca tutarsız oldu.

meanings.en: likely to change; not constant
meanings.exampleEn: The weather in spring is highly variable.
meanings.exampleTr: İlkbaharda hava son derece değişkendir.

meanings.en: to mention or look at something for information
meanings.exampleEn: Please refer to page ten for further details.
meanings.exampleTr: Daha fazla ayrıntı için lütfen onuncu sayfaya bakın.

meanings.en: to spoil or damage the quality or reputation of something
meanings.exampleEn: The scandal threatened to taint his political career.
meanings.exampleTr: Skandal, siyasi kariyerini lekelemekle tehdit ediyordu.

meanings.en: a feeling that someone or something is unworthy of respect
meanings.exampleEn: She looked at the cheap imitation with disdain.
meanings.exampleTr: Ucuz taklide küçümsemeyle baktı.

meanings.en: a feeling of dissatisfaction with one's situation
meanings.exampleEn: Growing discontent among workers led to a strike.
meanings.exampleTr: İşçiler arasında büyüyen hoşnutsuzluk bir greve yol açtı.

meanings.en: a lack of steadiness or agreement between things
meanings.exampleEn: There was an inconsistency between his words and his actions.
meanings.exampleTr: Sözleri ile eylemleri arasında bir tutarsızlık vardı.

meanings.en: in a convenient or easy way
meanings.exampleEn: The team won the match handily by ten points.
meanings.exampleTr: Takım maçı on sayı farkla rahatlıkla kazandı.

meanings.en: in a way that causes trouble or difficulty
meanings.exampleEn: The store is inconveniently located far from the city centre.
meanings.exampleTr: Mağaza, şehir merkezinden uzakta elverişsiz bir konumda.

meanings.en: not following accepted customs or practices
meanings.exampleEn: Her unconventional teaching methods surprised the parents.
meanings.exampleTr: Alışılmadık öğretim yöntemleri ebeveynleri şaşırttı.

meanings.en: on the contrary; in the opposite way
meanings.exampleEn: He expected praise; contrariwise, he received harsh criticism.
meanings.exampleTr: Övgü bekliyordu; aksine, sert eleştiri aldı.

meanings.en: the outer edge or boundary of an area
meanings.exampleEn: New houses were built on the periphery of the town.
meanings.exampleTr: Kasabanın çevresinde yeni evler inşa edildi.

meanings.en: a circle of light around the head of a holy figure, or around the sun or moon
meanings.exampleEn: A bright halo appeared around the moon that night.
meanings.exampleTr: O gece ayın etrafında parlak bir hale belirdi.

meanings.en: a circle of light surrounding something, especially in art
meanings.exampleEn: The saint in the painting was surrounded by a golden aureole.
meanings.exampleTr: Tablodaki aziz altın bir haleyle çevriliydi.

meanings.en: the quality of being wrong or inaccurate
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher pointed out the incorrectness of his answer.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen, cevabının yanlışlığına dikkat çekti.

meanings.en: having the same colour, pattern, or design as another item
meanings.exampleEn: She wore a blue dress with matching shoes.
meanings.exampleTr: Mavi bir elbiseyle ona uyan ayakkabılar giydi.

meanings.en: expensive; costing a lot of money
meanings.exampleEn: The restaurant was nice but a bit pricey for us.
meanings.exampleTr: Restoran güzeldi ama bizim için biraz pahalıydı.

meanings.en: a house that has only one storey
meanings.exampleEn: They retired to a small bungalow by the sea.
meanings.exampleTr: Deniz kenarındaki küçük bir bungalova çekildiler.

meanings.en: a person from the same country as another
meanings.exampleEn: He met a compatriot while travelling abroad.
meanings.exampleTr: Yurt dışında seyahat ederken bir vatandaşıyla tanıştı.

meanings.en: polite and courteous behaviour
meanings.exampleEn: They treated each other with civility despite their disagreement.
meanings.exampleTr: Anlaşmazlıklarına rağmen birbirlerine nezaketle davrandılar.
